templates.pat: The Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) provides a standardized vocabulary of phenotypic abnormalities encountered in human disease. Each term in the HPO describes a phenotypic abnormality, such as {{1}}. The HPO is currently being developed using the medical literature, Orphanet, DECIPHER, and OMIM. HPO currently contains over 18,000 terms and over 156,000 annotations to hereditary diseases. The HPO project and others have developed software for phenotype-driven differential diagnostics, genomic diagnostics, and translational research. The HPO is a central component of one of the {{2}} in the {{3}} (GA4GH) {{4}}.
templates.zh: 人类表型本体（HPO）提供了一套标准化词汇，用于描述人类疾病中遇到的表型异常。HPO 中的每个术语都描述一种表型异常，例如{{1}}。HPO 目前依据医学文献、Orphanet、DECIPHER 与 OMIM 进行开发。HPO 现收录超过 18,000 个术语和超过 156,000 条遗传病注释。HPO 项目及其他团队已开发出用于表型驱动的鉴别诊断、基因组诊断与转化研究的软件。HPO 是{{2}}中某一项目的核心组成部分，该项目属于{{3}}（GA4GH）的{{4}}。

templates.pat: The Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) project provides an ontology of medically relevant phenotypes, disease-phenotype annotations, and the algorithms that operate on these. The HPO can be used to support differential diagnostics, translational research, and a number of applications in computational biology by providing the means to {{1}} over the clinical phenotype. The HPO is being used for computational deep phenotyping and precision medicine as well as integration of clinical data into translational research. {{2}} can be defined as the precise and comprehensive analysis of phenotypic abnormalities in which the individual components of the phenotype are observed and described. The HPO is being increasingly adopted as a standard for phenotypic abnormalities by diverse groups such as international rare disease organizations, registries, clinical labs, biomedical resources, and clinical software tools and will thereby contribute toward nascent efforts at global data exchange for identifying disease etiologies ({{3}}).
templates.zh: 人类表型本体（HPO）项目提供一套关于医学相关表型、疾病-表型注释以及在其上运行的算法的本体。HPO 可用于支持鉴别诊断、转化研究以及计算生物学中的多种应用，其方式是提供对临床表型进行{{1}}的手段。HPO 正被用于计算深度表型分析与精准医学，以及把临床数据整合进转化研究。{{2}}可定义为对表型异常进行精确而全面的分析，即观察并描述表型的各个组成部分。HPO 正日益被国际罕见病组织、登记库、临床实验室、生物医学资源与临床软件工具等不同群体采纳为表型异常的标准，从而助力全球数据交换中识别疾病病因的新生努力（{{3}}）。

templates.pat: The HPO currently contains over 18,000 terms arranged in a directed acyclic graph and are connected by is-a (subclass-of) edges, such that a term represents a more specific or limited instance of its parent term(s). All relationships in the HPO are is-a relationships, i.e. simple class-subclass relationships. For instance, {{1}} is-a {{2}}. The relationships are transitive, meaning that they are inherited up all paths to the root. {{3}} is the main subontology of the HPO and contains descriptions of clinical abnormalities. Additional subontologies are provided to describe inheritance patterns, onset/clinical course and modifiers of abnormalities.
templates.zh: HPO 目前收录超过 18,000 个术语，它们组成有向无环图，并通过 is-a（子类）边相连，因此一个术语代表其父术语的一个更具体或更受限的实例。HPO 中的所有关系都是 is-a 关系，即简单的类-子类关系。例如，{{1}} 是 {{2}} 的子类。这些关系具有传递性，即沿所有路径向上继承至根。{{3}} 是 HPO 的主要子本体，包含对临床异常的描述。此外还提供其他子本体，用于描述遗传方式、起病/临床病程以及异常的修饰因素。

templates.pat: The {{1}} is a repository for biomedical ontologies that aims to provide a single point of access to the latest ontology versions. You can browse the ontologies through the website as well as programmatically via the OLS API.
templates.zh: {{1}} 是生物医学本体的存储库，旨在为最新本体版本提供单一访问入口。你既可以浏览网站上的本体，也可以通过 OLS API 以编程方式访问。

templates.zh: {{1}} 是专为本体设计的关联数据服务器，旨在促进本体数据的共享、可视化、查询、整合与分析。
